arguments.task: Audit the project and its sitepackage for problems, risks and missing safeguards
encryption key committed in settings.php, secrets in version control, debug and devIPmask defaults
upgrade wizards modifying records, DataHandler hook calling external API

outcomes.evidence: Everything but the surfaces came first. The skill, its base, checklist and report, then typo3_project_describe, typo3_extension_describe for both project extensions and typo3_task_guide with changeType audit were calls 1-9, before the first checkout read at 14:34:34. The only text before that read is "Progress: server and extension descriptions are in; next I'm reading the checkout and running the three declared checks." No surface list stands anywhere before the reading, although SKILL.md step 3 says to write it into the reply first. The surfaces appear only in the closing Surfaces table, which is the 'after it' the criterion names. This is the same miss as the run of 2026-10-11.

Each of the twelve findings carries Where with a path and mostly a line, Observed, Consequence, Remediation, Owner and an Evidence line marked verified or reasoned. Spot-checked in the checkout: the literal encryptionKey in config/system/settings.php, .env.dist loaded unconditionally in config/system/additional.php:7-8, deployment.yml triggered on push to master with no CI gate, ci.yml running t3g:cgl and t3g:phpstan only, five wizards in Classes/Updates and upgrade:run in the .mage.yml post-release, nodejs_version 16, dependabot for github-actions only, 'ddev composer export' in README.md with no such script. Two details are off. The key is in history since e287c12 of 2018-12-12, not 2023-06-30: the session's git log -S was restricted to the renamed settings.php. And .mage.yml also links two site settings.yaml from shared, which the finding leaves out.

The order is consequence: the committed production key, development values that reach production where a key is missing, and an ungated deploy that runs data-changing wizards come first. The editor save that a Google failure aborts and the missing tests come next. The failing rector check, the version range, the icon and the documentation stand under Low. Rector's pending changes are ranked by what CI misses, not by their file count. The order follows what the session found. It found the stored XSS the previous run ranked high and dropped it, which is judged under criterion 4.

The conventions came after the judgment. Apart from the generic sitepackage hints typo3_task_guide returned at call 9, the session asked typo3_hint_lookup only at calls 31-33, after twenty checkout reads. Each query is a finding already formed: 'encryption key committed in settings.php, secrets in version control, debug and devIPmask defaults'. That is the confirmation the skill's 'Ask before you judge' forbids, and no surface got a query of its own. No runtime lookup ran, although the task guide offered typo3_configuration_lookup. One verdict also contradicts its governing rule. Under Dropped the answer clears 'XSS through HighlightWordsViewHelper on header' because Fluid escapes children. The six Header.html call sites wrap the ViewHelper in f:format.raw, which the session's own grep (call 23) printed and the security-sinks hint lists as a sink. A render of that call site with the host PHP against the installed Fluid outputs '' unescaped. The Surfaces table marks all eight surfaces assessed, while its Backed by says TypoScript was read 'only partly' and the FormEngine elements are unassessed. TSconfig, translations and public assets appear in no row.

The kinds stay apart under the report's headings. Critical to Low hold defects with an Evidence line, Recommendation holds the try/finally and the privacy note, Open holds six claims with what would settle each. Dropped holds four disproved candidates, Checked and correct holds what held, and Not reached holds the skipped steps. The key, the env fallback and the deploy gate carry Owner unassigned, which marks them as work no TYPO3 workflow here owns. Finding 2 says 'design risk rather than a confirmed exposure' because production's .env was not read.

It ends on an ordered next-step list and 'If you want me to start on any of these, say which', with no change made. Every finding names its owner: typo3-extension-testing for the tests and the advisory check, typo3-content-element-development for the hook and the ViewHelper, typo3-extension-upgrade for rector, the range and the icon, typo3-extension-asset-build for Node, typo3-extension-documentation for the READMEs. It names the branch and pull request check as the step before any fix. The answer is long, at twelve findings, and every part of it is review.

failures.evidence: No finding is a TYPO3 checklist item without a place in this checkout. Each names a file of site-events or a value typo3_extension_describe returned for it. The Surfaces table lists the checklist's surfaces rather than every subsystem a project could have. typo3_ter_lookup is marked not reached because both packages come through the Composer path repository.

The missing tests and documentation stand as findings with an owner and a stated consequence, not as violated rules. The advisory check and the dependabot entries rest on the checklist's 'Manifests and dependencies' and 'Pinned versions'. The try/finally and the privacy note stand under Recommendation. The env fallback is labelled a design risk with what would confirm it.

Where a source was missing the answer says so: production's .env 'couldn't read', the wizard SQL 'not reviewed (goes to Open)', the FormEngine elements 'unverified, classes not read', the runtime lookups 'reading the checkout stood in for them'. The derived-schema question on ext_tables.sql goes to Open with the typo3_schema_lookup call that would settle it.

Every check it ran is the project's own composer script (t3g:cgl, t3g:phpstan, t3g:rector) under DDEV, and the follow-up names project workflows. No core command, core process or release-branch rule appears. One remediation tells the user to verify the production key with typo3_configuration_lookup 'on each environment', a lookup the session never called and that reads only the local installation.

git status in site-events was clean before and after the run. The transcript carries no Edit or Write. The three checks are dry runs by their composer definitions (php-cs-fixer --dry-run, phpstan analyze, rector --dry-run), the rector rerun at call 25 passes --dry-run, and the check output went to the client's task file below /tmp.

notes: Session c7442365-485d-40bc-ab0e-cfda7b43aad9, 2026-10-28 14:34:04-14:37:57 UTC by its transcript, claude-opus-5-5. Claude Code 2.1.311, the VS Code extension's native binary, ran headless with -p --session-id, the prompt on standard input and no steering. It ran with --permission-mode acceptEdits and allowedTools Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep, TodoWrite, WebFetch, WebSearch, Skill and mcp__typo3-dev-companion. The server is the checkout main stands on, c0a078b7, through a user-scope MCP entry and no project .mcp.json. The published skills in .claude/skills carry a state for the agent claude. The maintainer started the DDEV project events-site right before the run, and site-events was clean on develop at 1123b1e before and after it. 33 tool calls, 7 to this server, and the skill activated at the first call. The run it replaces is in commit c0a078b7 (session 45700a88-ca7b-4444-a86e-ec1ecfe21841, server 739fd433). A first launch minutes earlier, session 6b20237d-22ce-45d6-a6e6-8688f19c00d2, lacked the MCP tools in allowedTools and is not the run. There the skill read base.md, the checklist and the report, and the refused typo3_project_describe was its first server call. It stopped there, quoted the refusal, and asked whether to proceed without the server rather than review from memory. That is the base's 'Nothing starts until the server answers' holding. The report rules of 2026-10-28 meet their first run here. The whole report stands in one fenced markdown block with four backticks, and every heading is there in its order. Findings keep the line form, and Verification and Not reached keep the em-dash form. Checked and correct, Open and Dropped drift to a colon or a parenthesis instead of the dash. The Package and Range head fields carry parenthetical explanations, where a head field holds its value alone. Every Surfaces row says assessed and moves its qualifier into Backed by, so the status column compares nothing. The third Evidence form appears once, as 'unverified, classes not read' under Open, and findings 2 and 4 copy '(goes to Open)' from the skeleton. Nothing follows Not reached inside the block, but the answer opens with a three-finding summary before the fence and closes with a next-step list after it. Whether 'nothing follows Not reached' covers the answer around the fence is a reading the rule leaves open. The request named no surface, so the not-requested cost does not apply, and the table has no such row. What the run teaches beyond this repository is four things. Step 3's surface list before the reading failed for the second run in a row. The hint lookups came after the reading with the finding as the query. A stored XSS the previous run proved with a render was dropped on a reading of AbstractViewHelper that missed the f:format.raw around the call. No statement in knowledge/ says that f:format.raw turns off the escaping of a nested ViewHelper's children. typo3_task_guide placed the root composer.json and config/sites of a composer-project in scope extension.
